levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No timeframe is stated, or it is vague (e.g., 'a while').

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names the specific timeframe given in the scenario (four days).

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Also describes how the concern has changed over that timeframe.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Answers only one of the two follow-up questions, or restates the scenario without adding detail.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Answers both follow-up questions using specific details drawn from the scenario.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Answers connect the two follow-ups into a coherent picture rather than treating them as separate facts.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Reflection is generic ('more detail is better') with no specific consequence named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Names one specific thing a professional could do with the precise version that they couldn't with the vague one.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Names two or more specific consequences of the vague version.

lookFors: Uses only details from the provided fictional scenario -- no real personal health information from the learner's own life appears anywhere.
Description names a specific timeframe, not a vague duration.
Follow-up answers reference specific details from the scenario, not generic statements.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
